What do the sentences 1 & 2 express and what is the difference between them?

The $1^{\text{st}}$ one is an affirmative sentence and the $2^{\text{nd}}$ one is a negative sentence. They express statement. So **a sentence which expresses/makes a statement or assertion is called an Assertive sentence.**

Now notice the $3^{\text{rd}}$ sentence and try to fill in the following gap with the right word. The $3^{\text{rd}}$ sentence expresses __________ and it is an Interrogative sentence. So **a sentence which expresses/asks a __________ is an Interrogative sentence.**

Now notice the sentences 4, 5 and 6. The sentences express proposal, advice and direction/instruction respectively, and these are Imperative sentences. So **a sentence which expresses __________ is called an Imperative sentence.**

Notice sentences no. 7 and no. 8. They express __________ and they are exclamatory sentences. So **a sentence which expresses __________ is an Exclamatory sentence.**

Now notice sentence no. 9. The sentence no. 9 expresses --------- and it is an Optative sentence. So **a sentence which expresses------------ is an Optative sentence.**
